brief: Squat red-brick silo about 16 ft across and 30 ft high, the brick laid in a mottled checker of red and salmon tones, capped by a low conical roof of weathered grey shingles with a slight overhang; a narrow vertical row of door openings runs up one side. It is one of a pair standing at the edge of a dense belt of oak and elm woods, with a center-pivot irrigation line crossing the bare field in front; the white ranch house and barn are across the road.
